testcase.name: Scenario: Stage the same command for two ribbon tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1040:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage the same command for two ribbon tabs ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has empty Part Tools and Part Manage targets ✔ And the command source is All Commands ✔ When the user double-clicks 2D Sketches in the source list for Part Tools ✔ Then the command appears in the Part Tools target and the target is marked as changed ✔ When the user selects the Part Manage target ✔ Then the target is empty and 2D Sketches is available in the source list ✔ When the user double-clicks 2D Sketches in the source list ✔ Then the command appears in the Part Manage target and that target is marked as changed ✔ When the user returns to the Part Tools target ✔ Then its staged 2D Sketches command remains present ✔ And the Part Tools target is marked as changed ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
